ncn.native_seeds: 0..runs-1 (README runs=10); evidence only, no new seed freeze
ncn.loss: mean(-logsigmoid(pos))+mean(-logsigmoid(-neg)); balanced sum, not average over both groups
ncn.training_epoch_coverage: PermIterator floor batching drops positive tail
ncn.optimizer: Adam GNN lr .0082 / predictor lr .0037, default weight_decay=0
ncn.features: provided floating node features; no learned global ID table
ncn.graph: full official TRAIN, all declared nodes; README native TEST uses TRAIN+VAL
ncn.selection: strict validation Hits@50 improvement; every epoch TEST diagnostics in native source; selected weights persistence must be bound by future wrapper
ncn.environment_discrepancy: README torch1.13.0/PyG2.2.0/OGB1.3.5; env Python3.10.8/PyTorch1.13.1/CUDA11.7, sparse0.6.16 with torch1.13.0 build identifiers
ncn.xlin_binding: Endpoint product captures encoder x before predictor residual xlin; common-neighbor/residual pools use x+xlin(x); NCNC recursion receives that updated x.
ncn.negative_sampling_defaults: Author passes edge_index and num_nodes, without method/force_undirected override; dependency defaults apply; actual sampled count/undirected duplicate identity uninspected.

pencil.node_count: all OGB declared nodes; numeric count uninspected
pencil.feature_variant: --use_features retains OGB attributes and binds feature_fusion=early by CLI default
pencil.weighted_token_binding: DatasetWrapper default use_edge_weight=False, omitted by run_lp.py loader calls

query_sampling.target_removal: both directions after node sampling/induced-subgraph extraction

training_query_sampling.coverage_caveat: roughly half per epoch; two-slice cycling can miss a record at odd N when rounding down; actual N uninspected

negatives.forbidden: full native TRAIN graph + self-loops, no heldout rejection
negatives.evaluation: all official split negatives; no HeaRT
negatives.dependency_defaults: Author passes edge_index, num_nodes, num_neg_samples without method/force_undirected override; no extra canonicalization established in inspected global sampler.

model.propagation: per layer: attention then residual Linear+GELU(dense_adj @ hidden); adjacency+local identity row-normalized
model.head: concatenate two endpoint task hidden states -> biased scalar

training.gradient_accumulation_steps_per_rank: floor(8/world_size); world_size<=8, effective total altered if nondivisible
training.partial_accumulation: takes final optimizer step; loss divisor remains configured per-rank accumulation count
training.distributed_padding: DistributedSampler default padding; runtime counts unverified

evaluation.metric: Hits@50 against shared official negative pool
evaluation.hit_tie_rule: positive score strictly > 50th highest negative; equality fails
evaluation.selection: strict validation Hits@50 improvement, first exact ties stay
evaluation.query_gather: nonshuffling DistributedSampler; interleaved gather trimmed to dataset length; sequential index assertion enabled

pencil.heart_config: same bytes as official collab config at pin, but --heart changes datasets/negatives/metric; not equivalent official setting
pencil.environment: README Python3.12 / PyG extensions CUDA12.4; requirements torch2.5.1/PyG2.6.1/OGB1.3.6/transformers4.46.2
pencil.external_data_zip: advertised in README; no archive or availability probe
